summary: This is a routine earnings-related Form 8-K filed by Interparfums, Inc. reporting its second-quarter 2026 results via a press release as Exhibit 99.1. The filing covers results of operations, regulation FD disclosure, guidance reaffirmation, and a dividend announcement under Item 8.01. No strategic transaction, restructuring, or special situation is involved. The registrant is the filer providing standard periodic disclosure. There are no deal terms, premium, or target/acquirer dynamics. The filing is ordinary financial reporting and thus does not qualify as a special situation.
